lines: Settled 101° at 4:12PM, in 101° to 102°. The noon lean was 99° to 100° at 79% — missed (forecast 99.2, off by 1.8°).
The market agreed at noon (99° to 100° at 68%) and both were wrong.

The high was set at 4:12PM — after the 1:51 PM six-hour group; the hourly reports topped out at 99°, 2° under the settlement — a peak between reports that the 5-minute feed or a corroborated TWC maximum would have seen.
The noon book: 0 of 2 lines paid.
Lesson: the runs ran cold by 1.8°; the recency-weighted bias window pulls that in from tomorrow.
